title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode2 Solving the Mystery

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, it looks like we're the first ones here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. It's not quite the time we agreed upon yet, so let's...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, wait, wait! What were you doing on top of that tree?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I was running a little late because of some class rep business, so I decided to take the short way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It looks pretty tall to me!
Honestly...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, you didn't have to do that since Nene and her friend aren't here yet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. To be fair, we are all ten minutes early.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'm glad I made it in time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to meet Nene's friend. I wonder what she's like!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What was her name? Byakkomachi...?
She's keen on learning more about Wonderlands×Showtime, so she must have an eye for talent!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She sounds like a very avid student.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She even asked to meet us at Phoenix Wonderland because she wants to learn as much as she can from the night show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I really hope she enjoys it!
Hello. You must be Kusanagi's friends.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Nice to meet you all. My name is Suzu Byakkomachi, and I need to thank you for this wonderful opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Kusanagi's told me all about Wonderlands×Showtime. I've been hoping to meet you for quite a while now.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I see.
You saw me leaving that meeting...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I was really far away, but I saw someone with perfect posture!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: E-Emu, you shouldn't start calling her by her first name so suddenly...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: No, that's okay. I was only a little surprised, since not many people do call me by it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Please feel free to use whichever you prefer, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry for getting us sidetracked.
Where were we...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I was definitely the person you saw that day, Otori, since I was scheduled to meet with the board then.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I would greatly appreciate it if you could all keep this between us.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I'd like for everyone at the academy to treat me like any other actor or actress.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it's incredible to think that a student is being given an opportunity to be involved with how Morinomiya is run...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
It is incredible.
I'm very grateful to Grandfather for giving me this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Oh, he's the chairman of the board of the Morinomiya Revue.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I understand, Morinomiya's chairman is quite the businessman...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I remember reading about how he became the chairman of the board after spending time as the president or one of the executives at several major companies...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
That's right.
When he was young, he apparently had a reputation for being a ruthless manager.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But he was actually a Morinomiya fan long before he ever became the board chair.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: He even used to take me to see shows with him when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I've always loved how dazzling Morinomiya's shows are. I wanted to stand in the spotlight on that stage...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: My family wanted me to enter the world of business, but then my grandfather said, “Why not try both...?”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Initially, all I did was sit in on some meetings. But I've been getting more and more opportunities lately to express my opinions regarding proposals, advertisements and such.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I remember hearing about a recent ticket campaign running on Morinomiya's social media...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Oh, that was actually my idea.
It was the result of us trying to get more young people to come see Morinomiya's shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm also learning a lot about management and stuff right now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My grandpa was the one who founded Phoenix Wonderland...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm doing everything I can to make it a place that's filled with smiling guests!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Your grandfather...?
You mentioned that your last name is Otori. Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, we also forget from time to time...
Her family runs the Otori Group.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
That explains why you're learning more about management...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But my brothers are always telling me how my ideas aren't practical.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When Phoenix Wonderland was having trouble attracting guests, I couldn't come up with any good ideas to turn things around...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I think you're really amazing, Suzu!
You're actually balancing your dreams with reality and making things work with everyone at Morinomiya!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna be just like you! I want to learn to do what you do as fast as I possibly can!

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Daddy! The night show's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've been chatting for quite a while now.
Why don't we find a good place to watch the show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Suzu seemed kinda sad for some reason...)
